children: The Nifty 50 index is down nearly 1,700 points from the August 3 closing of 24,774, which has now become the recent swing high. The sell-off over the last five sessions has meant that the Nifty is now down to testing its June series lows of 23,070, which it fell to on June 8, before rebounding. That level will be the most important one to watch on the downside. Most of the other global cues remain the same, with Brent Crude now above $108 a barrel, and the US bond yields on the 10-year note persisting above the 5% mark. All eyes tonight will be on the US Federal Reserve as the market as mostly priced in a 25 basis points rate hike. For the Nifty, sentiments are likely to remain weak till it remains below levels of 23,250 - 23,300, according to analysts. The Nifty Bank also broke below the 56,000 mark on the downside on Tuesday and the bulls would first be aiming to reclaim those levels. On the downside, 55,500 - 55,000 range will be watched as the index closed at the day's low. Payment aggregators Paytm, Pine Labs and others will be in the spotlight yet again today after the MDR announcement. Also watch for Mazagon Dock, Groww, BHEL and others. The NSE IPO anchor book also opens today. Watch this space for all the LIVE stock market updates.

title: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live Updates: Nifty looks to protect June swing lows ahead of Fed decision
